name: namaste-salesforce
description: A Ghost theme for Namaste Salesforce, built on NS Design System.

scripts.zip: npm run test:ci && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/namaste-salesforce.zip && zip -r dist/namaste-salesforce.zip . -x '*.git*' -x 'node_modules/*' -x 'dist/*' -x 'abstract/*' -x 'scripts/*' -x 'dummy-content/*' -x 'assets/css/*' -x 'assets/js/*' -x '*.DS_Store' -x '*.md' -x 'gulpfile.mjs' -x 'package-lock.json'

ga4_id.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). Leave empty to disable GA4 entirely.

posthog_key.description: PostHog project API key (phc_...). Leave empty to disable PostHog entirely.

posthog_host.description: PostHog API host. EU cloud by default; changing it later loses history.

onesignal_app_id.description: OneSignal app ID for web push. Leave empty to disable. Needs the worker file, see partial.

require_analytics_consent.description: Ask before loading GA4/PostHog. Nothing loads until the reader agrees.

ads_txt.description: ads.txt records (IAB authorised sellers), one per line. Leave empty if no ads are sold.
